just_in.title: Air India Launches 'Easy Connect' From Amritsar, Linking Punjab to 27 Global Destinations
just_in.excerpt: Punjab travelers can now fly internationally through Delhi without changing terminals or rechecking baggage, as Air India expands its hub-and-spoke model to its second regional city after Varanasi.
just_in.nri_angle: Punjab's large overseas community — with frequent travel to Canada, the US, UK, and Australia — gains a direct international gateway at Amritsar with seamless baggage and immigration handling.

just_in.title: Cancers Once Diagnosed at 60 Are Now Striking People in Their 30s and 40s, and Researchers Think They Know Why

just_in.nri_angle: HPV vaccination is standard in Western countries where most NRIs live; India's rollout and safety debate directly affects families with children in India.

just_in.excerpt: The filmmaker is personally shaping a special promotional asset to introduce audiences to the world of his upcoming film starring Ranbir Kapoor, Alia Bhatt, and Vicky Kaushal.
just_in.nri_angle: Love & War is a prestige Bollywood event film expected to drive significant theatrical demand among diaspora audiences worldwide.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Social Media Star Niharika NM Makes Bollywood Debut in Bhai Tera Star Hai
just_in.excerpt: The content creator-turned-actress, who walked away from a thriving social media career with over 6 million followers, stars alongside Raghav Juyal in the London-set comedy releasing July 31.
just_in.nri_angle: Niharika NM's trajectory from a Chapman University MBA in California to a multilingual film career in India mirrors the creative pull many diaspora Indians feel toward opportunities back home.

just_in.title: Indian-Origin Woman, 26, Shot Dead in Targeted Attack in Toronto
just_in.excerpt: Toronto police arrested 37-year-old Sharanjit Singh of Brampton and charged him with first-degree murder after Navneet Kaur was gunned down near Humberwood Boulevard. Her family alleges the accused had been harassing her after she rejected his marriage proposal.
just_in.image_caption: Toronto police launched a search after a 26-year-old Indian-origin woman was fatally shot in the Rexdale neighbourhood on July 24.
just_in.nri_angle: The killing adds to a growing list of violent deaths of Indian nationals in Canada, deepening anxiety among diaspora families and raising urgent questions about whether complaints of harassment and threats are being adequately addressed by Canadian authorities.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: First Kenyan-Born NFL Player Daniel Adongo Deported to Kenya by ICE
just_in.excerpt: The former Indianapolis Colts linebacker, who was twice found incompetent to stand trial and whose family says he suffers from a brain injury sustained while playing, was removed from the U.S. on June 20 after overstaying his visa for a decade.
just_in.nri_angle: Adongo's case highlights the precarious immigration status many foreign-born athletes face when careers in the U.S. end abruptly, leaving them without visa sponsorship and vulnerable to enforcement actions years later.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Bombay High Court Lets Gadkari Sue Meta, X, Google Over AI Deepfakes
just_in.excerpt: The civil suit over fabricated videos linking the Union minister to the E20 fuel programme could become a landmark test of platform liability and personality rights in India.
just_in.nri_angle: The case will test whether Indian courts can compel global tech platforms to act against AI-generated disinformation — a precedent relevant to diaspora members who rely on social media for news about Indian politics.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.nri_angle: Indian B1/B2 visa applicants face wait times of up to 10 months at consulates like Mumbai, yet India has not been named as a participating post in the $750 expedited appointment pilot, leaving hundreds of thousands of applicants without a fast-track option.
